body:
# Components

## AI Guard

* :bug: Prevent AI Guard HTTP pool workers from retaining request context (#12612 - @amarziali)

## Application Security Management (WAF)

* :bug: Fix Lambda AppSec processing without a source IP and duplicate cookies (#12994 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Prevent API Security sampling from hanging request threads (#12836 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Fix crash when remote config replaces the WAF handle during context creation (#12770 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Report effective AppSec state in app-started telemetry (#12741 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Add block_failure telemetry for Tomcat blocking enforcement failures (#12493 - @jandro996)

## Configuration at Runtime

* :bug: Fix stale _dd.dsm.enabled tag after remote config toggles Data Streams (#12939 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Keep global tags apart from span defaults in the config snapshot (#12937 - @dougqh)

## Continuous Integration Visibility

* :bug: Disable service discovery in CI Visibility agentless mode (#12908 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Fix ScalaTest retries overflowing the stack under sbt (#12887 - @daniel-mohedano)

## Data Streams Monitoring

* :bug: Skip DSM produce backlog for failed Kafka sends (#12920 - @johannbotha)
* :bug: Compute the DSM base hash at startup (#12879 - @purple4reina)

## Dynamic Instrumentation

* :bug: Fix instrumenting metric on multi-line expressions (#12928 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix typo reason debugger metrics (#12913 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix metric line probe on empty catch (#12865 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Add timeout check during Matches expression eval (#12832 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix equals and hashCode for Expressions (#12824 - @jpbempel)

## GraalVM native-image

* :bug: Initialize tag processors at native-image run time (#12762 - @Yeison2020)

## ML Observability (LLMObs)

* :bug: Drop APM traces when APM tracing is disabled and keep LLM Observability working (#12473 - @ncybul)
* :bug: Flush LLM Obs intake writer synchronously in serverless environments (#12249 - @purple4reina)

## Metrics

* :sparkles: Flush OpenTelemetry metrics by closing the MeterProvider (#12909 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Expose OpenTelemetry metrics shutdown through MeterProvider (#12317 - @bm1549)

## OpenFeature

* :sparkles: Add per-subject evaluation telemetry opt-out (#12884 - @leoromanovsky)
* :bug: Send feature flag exposures after evaluation, and let applications record them with ExposureHook (#12774 - @danyal002)
* :sparkles: Send Java SDK identity with Feature Flagging EVP events (#12575 - @leoromanovsky)
* :sparkles: Harden Agentless Feature Flags EVP delivery (#12477 - @leoromanovsky)

## OpenTracing

* :bug: Fix OpenTracing header injection in the shaded JAR (#12859 - @amarziali)

## Profiling

* :bug::closed_lock_with_key: Upgrade lz4-java to 1.12.1 (#13012 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles: Add experimental Datadog profiler option overrides (#12983 - @jbachorik)

## Telemetry

* :bug: Report effective AppSec state in app-started telemetry (#12741 - @jandro996)

## Trace context propagation

* :bug: Prevent IntelliJ test hangs when tracing executor tasks (#12989 - @mcculls)
* :bug: Fix mismatched _dd.p.ksr under concurrent sampling decisions with different rates (#12988 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix span propagation across Kotlin withContext and flowOn (#12953 - @mcculls)

## Tracer core

* :bug::zap: Skip Gosu SingleServingGosuClassLoader in classloader matching (#12811 - @Yeison2020)
* :bug: Fix partial query redaction caused by encoded ampersands (#12995 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles: Resolve direction-scoped OpenTelemetry names when reading span tags (OTLP/tag registry) (#12972 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix stale _dd.dsm.enabled tag after remote config toggles Data Streams (#12939 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Keep global tags apart from span defaults in the config snapshot (#12937 - @dougqh)
* :broom: Simplify TID header parsing error handling (#12927 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :bug: Prevent ClassLatch from latching wrappers with defaults methods (#12823 - @bric3)
* :bug: Fix split-by-tags for tags configured by OpenTelemetry name (#12814 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix ClassLatch never latching on Java 8 (#12799 - @dougqh)
* :sparkles: Update default query string obfuscation pattern (#12769 - @jandro996)
* :zap::broom: Improve span link encoding performance (#12768 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Emit OpenTelemetry semantic conventions on HTTP spans (#12765 - @zacharycmontoya)
* :broom: Replace FieldBackedContextAccessor with KeyWithValue (#12750 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles: Update dd-instrument-java to v0.0.6 (#12744 - @mcculls)
* :bug::zap: Parse Datadog trace and span id headers without exceptions (#12739 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Drop APM traces when APM tracing is disabled and keep LLM Observability working (#12473 - @ncybul)
* :bug: Fix NullPointerException from activating a null span in scope manager (#12451 - @dougqh)

## Tracer public API

* :bug: Reject out-of-range 20-digit decimal trace and span ids (#12929 - @PerfectSlayer)

# Instrumentations

## Apache Spark instrumentation

* :sparkles: Spark integration: stop collecting spark physical plan (#12919 - @aboitreaud)
* :sparkles: Tag Spark application, job and stage spans with the serializer (#12712 - @aboitreaud)

## AWS Lambda instrumentation

* :bug: Fix Lambda AppSec processing without a source IP and duplicate cookies (#12994 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Parse X-Forwarded-Port in Lambda without exceptions (quick fix) (#12791 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Flush LLM Obs intake writer synchronously in serverless environments (#12249 - @purple4reina)

## AWS SDK instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add AWS resource ARN tags to AWS SDK client spans (#12812 - @sarahchen6 / #12598 - @pedramsafaei
 thanks for the contribution!)

## Azure Functions instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add Azure Durable Functions tracing support (#12618 - @jcstorms1)

## Core Java language instrumentation

* :bug::zap: Avoid capturing request context in OpenJDK 25 virtual-thread timeout tasks (#12851 - @amarziali)
* :bug: Fix startup deadlock with virtual threads (#12786 - @amarziali)
* :bug: Prevent context retention in OpenJDK virtual pollers and HttpClient selector (#12626 - @amarziali)

## JDBC instrumentation

* :bug: Fix DB2 JDBC URL parsing failure when :// is only in a property value (#12803 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix Oracle and jTDS JDBC URL parsing failures (#12780 - @dougqh)

## Jetty instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add Jetty 12.0 native WebSocket tracing and fix upgrade span completion (#12674 - @ygree)

## JMS instrumentation

* :bug: Fix invalid shaded helper package names (#12925 - @mcculls)
* :broom: Convert JMSDecorator.getDestination to ClassLatch (#12720 - @dougqh)

## Kafka instrumentation

* :bug: Skip DSM produce backlog for failed Kafka sends (#12920 - @johannbotha)

## Kotlin instrumentation

* :bug: Fix span propagation across Kotlin withContext and flowOn (#12953 - @mcculls)
* :bug: Fix Kotlin coroutine context isolation and continuation ownership (#12914 - @mcculls)

## Netty instrumentation

* :bug: Fix context propagation during Netty task cancellation (#12825 - @amarziali)
* :sparkles: Clear Reactor Netty request context when pooled connections are released (#12763 - @amarziali)

## OpenTelemetry instrumentation

* :sparkles: Flush OpenTelemetry metrics by closing the MeterProvider (#12909 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Expose OpenTelemetry metrics shutdown through MeterProvider (#12317 - @bm1549)

## Play Framework instrumentation

* :bug: Fix Play server spans losing URL tags on a malformed Host port (quick fix) (#12790 - @dougqh)

## Reactor instrumentation

* :sparkles::zap: Skip unnecessary Reactor and Reactive Streams transformation work (#12969 - @amarziali)

## R2DBC instrumentation

* :bug: Fix unbounded batch resource normalization in R2DBC instrumentation (#12935 - @jordan-wong)
* :bug: Fix unfinished R2DBC query spans after filtering results (#12767 - @amarziali)

## Scala instrumentation

* :bug: Fix Scala firstCompletedOf continuation cleanup (#12681 - @amarziali)

## Servlet instrumentation

* :bug: Skip storing the dispatcher target when the servlet context returns no dispatcher (#12802 - @dougqh)

## Spring instrumentation

* :bug: Fix Spring Rabbit listener scope close order (#12698 - @amarziali)

## Tomcat instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add block_failure telemetry for Tomcat blocking enforcement failures (#12493 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Guard Tomcat CoyoteAdapter advice against null-scope NPE (#12375 - @dougqh)

## Undertow instrumentation

* :bug: Fix NPE in Undertow decorator when the request line fails to parse (#12730 - @dougqh)

## WebSocket Instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add Jetty 12.0 native WebSocket tracing and fix upgrade span completion (#12674 - @ygree)
* :bug: Fix NullPointerException from activating a null span in scope manager (#12451 - @dougqh)
